article.title: Repeals
article.content:
395Repeals



Article 395 · Part XXII


The Indian Independence Act, 1947, and the Government of India Act, 1935, together with all enactments
                amending or supplementing the latter Act, but not including the Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction
                Act, 1949, are hereby repealed.
